mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent Fed tightening actions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the unemployment signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the housing starts signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the industrial production signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances following a Fed rate cut, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent easing monetary policy effects.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises & UNRATE falls in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the joint signal, or the combination of RSAFS increase and UNRATE decrease does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal, or PAYEMS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the GDP signal, or GDPC1 increase does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.
